strategies.name: skill-only
strategies.prompt_prefix: Apply the io-delegation skill to this task. Localize first. Prefer deterministic search and targeted reads. Delegate only if an approved worker is actually configured and beneficial; otherwise continue with selective reads. Keep debugging, architecture, sensitive decisions and final edits in the main agent.

strategies.name: skill-hooks
strategies.prompt_prefix: Apply the io-delegation skill to this task. Localize first. Prefer deterministic search and targeted reads. Obey the installed read guard; do not bypass it by switching tools. Delegate only if an approved worker is actually configured and beneficial; otherwise continue with bounded reads. Keep debugging, architecture, sensitive decisions and final edits in the main agent.
